qualifier: antigen receptor (BCR) signaling and its regulation
name: B cell receptor signaling and its regulation in activation
rationale: All members concern B cell activation, proliferation and differentiation driven and tuned by BCR signaling (second messengers, RAS, BTK, CD22, activation brakes), which distinguishes it from B cell expression signatures, T cell receptor signaling and plasma/memory B cell differentiation confusables.

qualifier: ILK complex and Rho effector cytoskeletal remodeling
name: Integrin-mediated cell spreading and migration via Rho-effector cytoskeletal remodeling
rationale: Members share integrin-dependent substrate adhesion, spreading and migration coupled to actin remodeling (PINCH-ILK-parvin, ROCK, PAK, SRF targets), distinguishing it from Rap1/MAPK integrin signaling, fibronectin matrix assembly and platelet/stress-fiber confusables.

core: Germline and early embryonic genome programs
qualifier: meiotic chromosome mechanics, transposon silencing, maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Germline meiosis, transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members cover germ cell meiosis (recombination, synapsis, cohesion, spindle), germline genome defense (piRNA, KRAB-ZFP, HUSH), imprinting and the oocyte-to-zygote transition, distinguishing it from sperm motility/fertilization and gonadal hormone confusables.

qualifier: GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose and their CDGs
name: GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthesis and glycosylation disorders
rationale: All members concern making the mannose donors GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose (MPI, PMM2, PGM1, DPM1-3, DOLK, SRD5A3) and their congenital glycosylation defects, distinguishing it from dolichol synthesis and ALG lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly confusables.

qualifier: vRNP nuclear import, transcription, export and host antiviral evasion
name: Influenza virus RNP replication cycle and host antiviral evasion
rationale: All members are steps of the influenza life cycle (vRNP nuclear import, vRNA/mRNA synthesis, NEP/NS2 export, translation, NS1 inhibition of PKR and host mRNA processing), distinguishing it from coronavirus and RSV replication confusables.

qualifier: aminoacylation, cytosolic and mitochondrial, with RNA pseudouridylation
name: tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation, cytosolic and mitochondrial
rationale: Members center on tRNA end processing, splicing, base modification (wobble, methylation, pseudouridine) and aminoacylation in both compartments, distinguishing it from rRNA modification/mitoribosome, wybutosine/t6A and 5'-leader removal confusables.

qualifier: ISG effector restriction of the viral life cycle
name: Interferon-stimulated gene effector restriction of viral life cycle
rationale: Members share the interferon-induced antiviral effector program (IFN-alpha/gamma response signatures, ISG15, restriction of viral replication, release and entry), distinguishing it from upstream RIG-I/TLR/IRF3 sensing-induction and IFN-gamma/MHC class II confusables.

core: Regulation of pancreatic islet hormone secretion
qualifier: incretin and nutrient-sensing GPCRs
name: Incretin and nutrient GPCR control of insulin and glucagon secretion
rationale: Members concern GPCR inputs (GLP-1, GIP, glucagon, FFAR1, HCA, acetylcholine, somatostatin) regulating islet hormone secretion, distinguishing it from PKA/metabolic glucagon signaling, calcitonin/amylin receptor and KATP channel confusables.

qualifier: adherens junction maintenance and apical constriction
name: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and adherens junction maintenance
rationale: All members concern establishing and maintaining epithelial apical-basal and cytoskeletal polarity with adherens-junction cell-cell adhesion, distinguishing it from podocyte, desmosome, adherens junction assembly and generic junction confusables.

qualifier: inhibitory receptor restraint of phagocyte and B cell activation
name: Fc-gamma receptor signaling and inhibitory receptor restraint of activation
rationale: Members combine FcgammaR activation with inhibitory receptor signaling (SIRP, CD22, inhibitory Fc receptors) that dampens phagocytosis, neutrophil and BCR activation, distinguishing it from ADCC/hypersensitivity, phagocytic cup and macrophage signature confusables.

qualifier: glycogen synthesis and degradation enzymes and their storage diseases
name: Glycogen synthesis and degradation and their storage diseases
rationale: Members concern glycogen synthesis, branching, glycogenolysis and glycophagy and the diseases of those enzymes (GYS1/2, GBE1, GYG1, GAA, Lafora), distinguishing it from glucose-6-phosphatase, glucokinase regulation and glycolysis confusables.

core: Cellular responses to membrane mechanical stress
qualifier: calcium entry, ATP release and gap-junction coupling
name: Mechanosensitive calcium entry, ATP release and gap-junction coupling
rationale: Members link mechanical and osmotic membrane stress (pressure, volume, blebbing, repair, PIEZO1) to channel-mediated calcium influx, ATP export and gap-junction/glial signaling, distinguishing it from endothelial shear-stress, connexon trafficking and glutamate receptor confusables.

qualifier: PAPS and nucleotide-sugar transport with chondrodysplasias
name: PAPS and nucleotide-sugar donor supply and skeletal chondrodysplasias
rationale: Members concern producing and transporting PAPS, sulfate and nucleotide sugars (PAPSS2, SLC26A2, SLC35D1, UDP-glucuronate) whose defects cause chondrodysplasias, distinguishing it from GAG chain synthesis, selenocysteine and SLC35 CDG confusables.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
name: Intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
rationale: All members describe the early urogenital lineage from intermediate mesoderm through nephric/mesonephric duct to ureteric bud induction and branching, distinguishing it from confusables on bud elongation, renal vesicle and nephron progenitor proliferation.

qualifier: mitochondrial and death-receptor apoptosis, execution and necroptosis
name: Mitochondrial and death-receptor apoptosis, execution phase and necroptosis
rationale: Members span BH3-only/BAX-BAK MOMP and apoptosome, TRAIL/Fas caspase-8 signaling, execution-phase DNA fragmentation and RIPK1 necroptosis, distinguishing it from p53 death-gene transcription and T cell activation-induced death confusables.

qualifier: induction of IL-12, IL-23, IL-10, GM-CSF and IFN-gamma production
name: C-type lectin receptor antifungal sensing and cytokine induction
rationale: Members share Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN recognition of fungal and lectin ligands driving cytokine production, distinguishing it from confusables about IL-17, IL-12/23 and IL-10/27 cytokine signaling rather than production.

qualifier: developing kidney and lymphohematopoietic tissues
name: Cell number control in developing kidney, bone marrow and thymus
rationale: Members concern proliferation, survival and differentiation control setting cell number in kidney development, bone marrow and thymic/B lymphopoiesis, distinguishing it from hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis and kidney size/glomerulus confusables.

qualifier: pressure, blebbing, volume and repair rather than lipid scrambling
name: Plasma membrane mechanical stress responses: pressure, blebbing, volume, repair
rationale: All members concern how the plasma membrane responds to mechanical load (PIEZO1 signaling, hydrostatic pressure, blebs, volume decrease, repair), distinguishing it from phospholipid scrambling, flippase and apoptotic-cell clearance confusables.

qualifier: otic vesicle-derived structures and vestibulocochlear nerve
name: Otic vesicle-derived inner ear and vestibulocochlear nerve morphogenesis
rationale: All members describe structural formation of the inner ear (otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canals, cochlear-vestibular nerve), distinguishing it from hair cell fate/vestibular function, craniofacial, pharyngeal gland and eye confusables.

qualifier: fatty acid and glycerol efflux, receptor sensing and thermogenic cycling
name: Adipose fatty acid and glycerol efflux, sensing and thermogenic cycling
rationale: Members concern export and transport of fatty acids, glycerol and urea, free fatty acid/hydroxycarboxylic acid receptor sensing and futile-cycle thermogenesis, distinguishing it from brown/beige/white adipocyte differentiation and water aquaporin confusables.

core: Endocrine control of growth, appetite and glucocorticoids
qualifier: GH, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling
name: GH, prolactin and leptin signaling; growth, appetite, glucocorticoid control
rationale: Members combine GH, prolactin and leptin JAK-STAT receptor signaling with ghrelin, feeding behavior, body growth and ACTH/glucocorticoid secretion, distinguishing it from neuropeptide-behavior, gut GPCR hormone and stress-response confusables.

qualifier: modification and processing with mitoribosome assembly and pseudouridylation
name: Mitochondrial RNA modification, processing and mitoribosome assembly with pseudouridylation
rationale: Members concern processing and modification of mitochondrial tRNA, rRNA and mRNA, pseudouridine synthesis and mitoribosome subunit assembly, distinguishing it from aminoacylation/translation, cytosolic tRNA and mtDNA transcription/replication confusables.

qualifier: arginine, lysine and ornithine transporters and their disorders
name: Cationic amino acid transport and its inherited disorders
rationale: All members concern transport of arginine, lysine and ornithine (SLC7A7, SLC25A15) and the diseases of those transporters, distinguishing it from urea cycle enzyme, dicarboxylate and neutral amino acid transport confusables.

core: Placental and early embryonic lineage development
qualifier: trophoblast differentiation with ICM/germline stem cell maintenance
name: Placental trophoblast development and early embryonic stem cell lineages
rationale: Members cover trophoblast differentiation, migration and labyrinth formation, decidualization, and early lineages (inner cell mass, trophectoderm, primordial germ cells, stem cell maintenance), distinguishing it from eye/vascular, germ cell maturation and mammary gland confusables.

qualifier: compartment-specific interconversion
name: Compartment-specific phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate interconversion
rationale: All members concern synthesis and interconversion of PIPs at specific membranes and of soluble inositol phosphates, distinguishing it from PI synthesis, ER-membrane lipid transfer and ER morphology confusables.
